items.title: Block DNS threats with Infoblox rules in Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall
items.summary: Infoblox Threat Defense is now available in preview in Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall, providing partner-managed DNS threat intelligence. Learn how to add an Infoblox managed rule to a rule group, test it in alert mode, monitor matches, and move to blocking.
items.creator: Rajendra Kulkarni
